{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: 'A modified racing truck tears up the treacherous mountain road, kicking up clouds of dust as it barrels along the gravel switchbacks.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory821.png', 4: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bridget', 3: 'Poor visibility up ahead!', 4: '1'}
{3: "Bridget grips the wheel in the driver's seat, her focus absolute."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory821.png', 4: '3', 5: '1'}
{3: 'Several hours earlier.'}
{3: 'To make good on a promise, you meet up with Bridget at the foot of a deserted mountain pass.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Bridget', 3: "I stumbled across this track by chance during a delivery. Took it for a spin myself, and turns out it's a famous circuit from the Golden Age called the Bayanbulak.", 4: '1'}
{2: "I've heard about it.", 3: '28', 4: "So that's what it means.", 5: '28'}

{2: 'Bridget', 3: "Racers could only run this course two or three times a year during official events back in the day, according to the regulations, but now that it's abandoned? We've got free rein. Talk about hitting the jackpot.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: "I ran a few laps on my own, but I couldn't really push it without a co-driver. That's why I put together that pacenote book for you.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: 'With you as my co-driver, I can finally floor it.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory821.png', 4: '3'}
{2: 'Left 6 into big jump! 100 into dip, caution!', 3: '38'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: 'The engine shudders violently. The moment the speeding truck slams back down, it bucks hard against the ground.'}
{3: 'Any other truck would have been torn apart by now, but Bridget modified this one herself.'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Disable'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab'}
{3: "Both of you hold your breath. The truck's frame weathers the impact, running smooth as ever."}
{2: 'Good landing!', 3: '54'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bridget', 3: 'Ha! Knew you could handle it, Bulak!', 4: '1'}
{2: "Is that the truck's name? Did you just come up with it?", 3: '57', 4: "Woah! C'mon, Bulak!", 5: '59'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: "Yeah! It's a tribute to the land we're racing on!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'What a callback.', 3: '59', 4: "As long as you're happy.", 5: '59'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: "We've got the momentum. Let's floor it!", 4: '1'}
{2: '200 into cliff, brake!', 3: '65'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: 'How can I hold back right now?', 4: '1'}
{2: "Watch out! Don't!", 3: '70', 4: 'Then floor it!', 5: '70'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: "As if responding to its driver's fervor, the truck's systems surge to their absolute limits."}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: 'Give in to the adrenaline!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Disable'}
{3: 'With no signs of slowing down, the roaring truck barrels toward the finish line.'}

{3: "At the last possible moment, Bridget wrenches the wheel hard, then snaps it back while yanking the handbrake, locking the rear wheels instantly. The truck's tail arcs through the gravel as the car slides sideways into the apex."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: "The truck's body lurches violently at the apex, its suspension bottoming out as gravel sprays from beneath the rear wheels."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory821.png', 4: '3', 5: '1'}
{3: 'You eventually come to a stop without incident. But when you get out to inspect the truck, the hood is hot enough for barbecue.'}
{3: 'Both of you hurriedly take off your helmets, unfastening your fireproof suits to let some air in.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bridget', 3: 'Let me check the time... Just over an hour.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: 'Still nowhere near the old record, though.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Bridget walks around the truck and gives the rear tire a kick. The tread is nearly gone.'}
{2: 'We were driving a race truck, after all.', 3: '104'}
{2: "No one's taken a truck down this route before, right?", 3: '105'}
{2: "Which means you're the truck racing record holder of this course.", 3: '106'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: 'Mm... I like the way you think, Commandant.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: 'But it\'s "we," Commandant. We\'re the record holders.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: "But hey, don't underestimate Bulak. I've poured plenty of my salary and sweat into her.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1335.jpg'}
{3: 'This cliff at the mountaintop is the perfect spot to watch the sunset.'}
{3: "It is still the rainy season, so the air still holds some moisture. Up here by the cliff's edge at altitude, the clouds drift below you, and the sunset spills across an endless sea of clouds."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bridget', 3: "Who says there's no ocean here?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Bridget snaps out of her excitement and pulls a glass bottle from her bag.'}
{3: 'She crouches by the roadside where the tires tore through, loosening some dirt with a chisel before scooping it into the bottle.'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: 'Consider this a gift for you. I want to take some of this soil back.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Something to remember this by.', 3: '126', 4: 'Is this some kind of tradition?', 5: '128'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: 'Yeah. The earth where the wheels trod is still warm.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: "It's romance, okay? Don't kill the mood.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: "Some racers do collect dirt from the course as a keepsake. It's a tradition passed down through the years.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: 'This humble dirt is the mark we left on this land. Proof that we were here.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'While you are still admiring the sea of clouds, Bridget hauls over a large crate of chilled drinks. She stashed them at the finish line before the race even began.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bridget', 3: "It's pretty hot in these suits. Here—I picked your favorite.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Popping open the caps, the two of you clink glasses, and the bottles chime with a crisp ring.'}
{3: 'The chilled drink and cool breeze wash away the heat clinging to your body.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory550.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory550.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Bridget', 3: "I'm glad you were my navigator when my dream came true, Commandant.", 4: '1'}
{2: "An experience like this doesn't come around often.", 3: '149', 4: 'Thanks for choosing me as your navigator.', 5: '149'}
{2: 'So, what do you want to do next?', 3: '150'}
{3: 'Bridget downs her drink in one go, then pulls you down to lie beside her. The highland night sky stretches overhead, the stars shining brilliantly.'}
{2: 'Bridget', 3: "Stay with me and watch the stars. We'll head back once the Double Seventh Festival is over.", 4: '1'}
